newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria president accepts Vranitzky resignation.
newsitem.headline: Austria president accepts Vranitzky resignation.

text.p: Austrian President Thomas Klestil on Saturday accepted the resignation of Chancellor Franz Vranitzky and asked him to stay on in his post until his designated successor Viktor Klima takes over.
"I have accepted the resignation and asked (Vranitzky) to stay on in his post," Klestil told Austrian television.
Klestil, who is still recovering from a long bout of pneumonia, praised Vranitzky for leading Austria through turbulent years since he became chancellor in June 1986.
"I have thanked him in the name of the Austrian republic...for his hard work and responsible leadership," Klestil said.
Vranitzky said earlier he had no intention of standing for the presidency when Klestil's term of office expires next year.
Klestil said he hoped Klima would present his new cabinet lineup within the next few days.
